rationale: manhart_pwls_tv-claude-agentic: val_n=200, pwls_gamma=0.0, pwls_weight_norm=mean, tv_lambda=0.001, tv_iterations=200, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=fbp, rationale=iter-2 PWLS-ACTIVATION TEST. iter-1 (gamma=1.0, Manhart) gave hr=0.16648/ssim=0.9612. Mayo lesson: at tv_lambda=0.001 the TV term can dominate the data term ~1000x, making the PWLS ray-weight W=exp(-gamma*p) INERT (Mayo iter-1 g=1.0 vs iter-2 g=0.5 were bit-identical). ONE knob: pwls_gamma 1.0->0.0 (exactly plain TV; W==1 everywhere). HYPOTHESIS: if plain-TV (g=0) hr DIFFERS from iter-1's g=1.0, PWLS ray-weighting is LIVE on breast (128-view sparse data term bites harder than dense Mayo) and gamma is a real lever; if bit-identical, PWLS is inert here and I pivot to TV knobs (tv_lambda/lr/iterations). All else fixed from iter-1. Budget: iter-1 ran 199s<<1200s.
